result.answer:
What you agreed: only a conditional final review — you would review after the data check and layout exist, with no guaranteed 18:30 time. Nothing else was accepted; you explicitly said you had not agreed to the deadline or the full task set.

What remained proposals: He's plan (Rui checks sources until 18:20, Ning lays out confirmed content, you review after, and He sends the proposal with the summary marked pending if the check fails). Rui offered the source check but never committed; Ning offered layout pending a go-ahead; Rui's later note that the 'pending' wording needs care was unresolved. Not done: no data were actually checked, no owner of layout confirmed, Rui's commitment missing, and the pending-summary wording still open. He said he would tell the manager if conditions weren't met — his stated call, but the send itself hasn't happened.
